findingSummary: No definite visible defect requiring REVISE was found in the eight individually opened originals. PASS applies only to the observed saved-pixel layout and is based on the per-image observations, not manifest status or separate approvals.
staticViewLimits: Only the eight designated original image paths were opened, each once using view_image. There were no reopens, crops, zooms, derived images, or additional image opens.
The mobile text image was automatically scaled in its tool presentation. Exact small glyphs and fine mathematical or figure-line detail cannot be certified from that overview.
A saved image boundary is an evidence limit, not proof of a broken container. Nothing outside the saved pixels or in unseen states is assessed.
No interaction, answer judging, keyboard behavior, scrolling behavior, ARIA, complete English accessibility, font identity or loading, or headed acceptance is certified.
Source, science, English content, choice semantics, native, and DOM approvals remain separate and unchanged. They were not re-reviewed or extended by this saved-pixel review.
The copied input metadata identifies the manifest entries; image bytes and hashes were not independently recomputed.
